note: Jedi Pack inbox intent registry. Examples are paraphrased from the authored synthetic threads.

intents.description: Safe fallback when no registered intent clears the reject band. Asks a clarifying question, never guesses.
examples: hello there
what can you help me with
partnership proposal wholesale catalog
are you hiring a packer

intents.description: Customer wants money back for an order: a refund of a charge, or a return of payment.
examples: Please refund order JP-1042, the hilt color is not what I ordered
I want a refund of 400.00 GC for order JP-1104
Refund 90.00 GC for order JP-1077
I want to know if I can get my money back
I still need the 40.00 GC back
Any news on the refund, I still need the money back
The charge was 40.00 GC, refund the charge
Refund and my card details, send the card number I paid with
I want a refund for two items that arrived damaged, 35 GC for one and 65 GC for the other

intents.description: Customer received a damaged or wrong item and wants a replacement sent.
examples: The saber arrived cracked and I am asking you to replace it
Please replace the cracked hilt, send a replacement
I do not want a refund, I want a replacement saber
The blade arrived broken, ship me a new one
The saber arrived damaged, replace it
I do not want the money back, I want it replaced

intents.description: Customer asks a question about products, shipping, warranty or availability.
examples: Which blade colors can you ship to me this month
How many days from order to delivery for a standard hilt
How long is the warranty on a saber hilt
Do you engrave a name on the hilt
Do you sell a stand for the saber, or only the saber itself
I have not ordered yet, which colors do you ship
What does shipping cost and how long does delivery take
Where is my order of belts and holsters
Can I return a holster or a belt after delivery

intents.description: Customer complains about condition, service or listing and wants it noted, not money.
examples: The box arrived crushed, I want this noted, I am not asking for money
The delivery note was rude and the courier left the parcel in the rain
Please have a person look at this complaint
The end cap is missing, this is a complaint not a refund request
This is a public complaint, the photo on the listing does not match
I will keep this review up, do not buy from this shop

intents.description: Customer says thanks or praises the product, no request.
examples: Thank you, that solved it
Thanks for the quick note
The saber is beautiful and the hilt feels solid, five stars
I bought this as a gift and they loved it
Perfect, thanks
No question, just wanted you to know we love it

intents.description: Customer follows up on an earlier reply, disputes or corrects what was said.
examples: You misunderstood me, that is not what I asked
Your earlier reply is wrong, you said a refund is on the way
I asked for a replacement, not a refund
I did not ask for my money back, do not send a refund
Your reply says something I never asked, that is wrong
You said you would, any update on your earlier reply
As I said before, you misunderstood

intents.description: Customer asks for a price quote or bulk pricing for a number of items: a request for quote, not an order.
examples: Please quote 100 training sabers
We need a quote for 50 trainers for the new academy wing
Could you quote 25 units, we need them for a new school
What is your price for 100000 hilts
Request for quote: 250 utility belts delivered to Antwerp
bulk pricing for 500 holsters
RFQ for saber stands
how much for 1000 units of the padawan robe
price difference between 100 and 100000 items
